Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer and for being open about your capacity situation.

We are ready to give you the firm commitment you asked for: a binding 23,400 pieces per year for 24 months, and we accept a longer lead time of 56 days so you can plan production.

Our orders for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM were at EUR 28.94 until December 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10).
Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010).
Producer prices DE: other rubber products changed -0.3% from 2026-01 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-C2219@2026-01, idx:PPI-C2219@2026-02).

We therefore propose EUR 28.94 per piece, the price of our 2023 orders.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We accept your proposed terms of 23,400 units annually over a 24-month contract with a 56-day lead time.

While we have reviewed your historical price references, our pricing must reflect current operational realities and our high capacity utilization. In consideration of your extended commitment, we revise our offer to EUR 31.50 per unit. Our offer consists of a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Which volume can you commit to? Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your answer. We make a large step towards you: EUR 1.46 more per piece, and we extend the commitment to 36 months, 70,200 pieces in total.
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

We propose EUR 30.40 per piece.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have verified the labor cost index data and note your proposed 36-month contract term. In exchange for this extended commitment, we reduce our price to EUR 31.20 per unit. Given our current capacity utilization, this offer represents a realistic assessment of our operational constraints. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Consequently, our offer stands at a price of €31.20 per unit, a Lieferzeit of 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
